headlines.title: 报道：德鲁肯米勒称美国借贷成本仍“有点低”
headlines.summary: 据德鲁肯米勒（Stanley Druckenmiller）发言记录及多位知情人士消息，德鲁肯米勒向一个华尔街私人听众表示，美国的借贷成本仍然“有点低”。 德鲁肯米勒在纽约由Piper Sandler主办的一场会议上称：“鉴于当前经济状况、资本支出热潮以及资本争夺战，如果说有什么的话，（债券收益率似乎）有点低了。” 他表示：“收益率的上涨一直是一种缓慢的、由基本面驱动的攀升。但我完全不觉得令人担忧。” 德鲁肯米勒还表示，降息“已不再必要”。 他认为，那些认为货币政策具有紧缩性的央行官员“荒谬可笑”。（英国金融时报）

headlines.title_en: Report: Druckenmiller Says US Borrowing Costs Still "a Bit Low"
headlines.summary_en: According to a transcript of Stanley Druckenmiller's remarks and multiple people familiar with the matter, Druckenmiller told a private Wall Street audience that U.S. borrowing costs are still "a little low." Speaking at a conference hosted by Piper Sandler in New York, Druckenmiller said: "Given the current economic situation, the capex boom and the fight for capital, if anything, (bond yields seem) a little low." He said: "The rise in yields has been a slow, fundamentals-driven grind. But I don't find it worrying at all." Druckenmiller also said rate cuts are "no longer necessary." He called central bank officials who believe monetary policy is restrictive "ridiculous." (Financial Times)

headlines.title: 美元指数涨超0.2%
headlines.summary: 周四（9月10日）纽约尾盘，ICE美元指数涨0.26%，报99.070点，日内交投区间为98.706-99.199点，欧洲股市开盘以来持续上扬、北京时间20:39（欧洲央行宣布加息之后）创9月4日以来新高，脱离周三所创8月21日以来最低位98.599点。 彭博美元指数涨0.30%，报1190.47点，日内交投区间为1185.81-1191.64点，脱离周三所创5月6日（最低1184.67点）以来盘中最低位1184.82点。

headlines.summary_en: In late New York trading on Thursday (Sept. 10), the ICE U.S. Dollar Index rose 0.26% to 99.070, with an intraday range of 98.706-99.199. It had been rising steadily since the European stock market opened and hit a new high since Sept. 4 at 20:39 Beijing time (after the ECB announced its rate hike), moving away from the lowest level since Aug. 21 of 98.599 set on Wednesday. The Bloomberg Dollar Index rose 0.30% to 1190.47, with an intraday range of 1185.81-1191.64, moving away from the intraday low of 1184.82 set on Wednesday, the lowest since May 6 (low of 1184.67).

headlines.title_en: China Opposes Push by Certain Country to Impose UN Security Council Sanctions on Iran
headlines.summary_en: On the morning of Sept. 10 local time, certain member states of the UN Security Council, disregarding the huge differences that still exist within the Council on the relevant issue, insisted on pushing the Security Council to restore sanctions on Iran and pushed the Council to hold a meeting under a topic that had already been terminated. Sun Lei, China's deputy permanent representative to the United Nations, expressed serious concern and strong opposition in his remarks. Sun Lei pointed out that at present, the United States has stepped up unilateral sanctions on Iran and launched a new round of military strikes against Iran, with the U.S. and Iran attacking each other, tensions in the region have risen again, and efforts by all parties to promote peace and talks have been severely setbacks. China is highly concerned and deeply worried about this, and calls on the United States to commit to no longer using force and to negotiate in good faith with Iran. The parties concerned should abandon recourse to force or the threat of force, push the Iran nuclear issue back onto the track of political and diplomatic settlement, and seek the greatest common denominator that accommodates the reasonable demands of all sides regarding achieving a comprehensive and lasting ceasefire, reaching a peace agreement and a political and diplomatic solution to the Iran nuclear issue

headlines.title: China says yuan’s global rise is ‘irreversible’ – and has a strategy to back it up
headlines.summary:
Chinese financial authorities have pledged further steps to expand the yuan’s global use amid a broader de-dollarisation trend, while vowing to make listing on mainland stock exchanges the “primary” choice for top-tier domestic companies.
“The internationalisation of the yuan is a continuous and steady process, and an irreversible trend,” said Lu Lei, deputy governor of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), at a press conference on Thursday.

headlines.title_zh: 中国称人民币国际化趋势“不可逆转”——并已有配套战略
headlines.summary_zh:
中国金融当局承诺采取进一步措施扩大人民币的全球使用，顺应更广泛的去美元化趋势，同时誓言将内地证券交易所上市打造为顶级国内企业的“首选”。
“人民币国际化是一个持续稳定的过程，也是不可逆转的趋势，”陆磊表示。

headlines.title: Record China-US gap in bond yields unlikely to trigger capital flight: Marsh Investment
headlines.summary:
The widening yield spread between Chinese and American government bonds is unlikely to trigger catastrophic capital flight from China, according to investment executives at Marsh Investment, who attribute the record spread to the United States’ fiscal pressures and global macro trends rather than a structural retreat for Chinese assets.

headlines.title_en: Canada and Ukraine Sign Century-Long Partnership
headlines.summary_en: Canada and Ukraine signed a century-long partnership. Canada launched a national drone trading platform modeled on Ukraine's. Canada will provide Ukraine with a C$430 million guaranteed loan for natural gas projects.
